name: Ghanaian black-eyed pea and plantain red red
steps: Fry the onion in red palm oil until soft.
Stir in the tomato paste, ginger, and a pinch of chilli.
Add the tinned tomatoes and cook down into a thick sauce.
Fold in the black-eyed peas and simmer to warm through.
Pan-fry the ripe plantain slices in oil until golden.
Serve the bean stew topped with the fried plantain.
